name: A+AVD (Brentuximab vedotin / DOXOrubicin / Vinblastine / Dacarbazine)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Give antiemetic prophylaxis before each administration per the standard emetic-risk framework.

supportiveCare: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis is recommended with A+AVD (higher febrile-neutropenia risk than ABVD).
Brentuximab vedotin causes cumulative peripheral neuropathy; assess before each dose and dose-modify or hold for grade 2 or higher.
Bleomycin is replaced by brentuximab vedotin; do not co-administer bleomycin (pulmonary toxicity).
Baseline LVEF before anthracycline; track cumulative doxorubicin exposure.
monitoring: CBC with differential before each administration; monitor for febrile neutropenia
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each brentuximab dose

drugs.name: Brentuximab vedotin
drugs.notes: A+AVD 'A' (brentuximab). Brentuximab vedotin 1.2 mg/kg IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle (front-line A+AVD dosing; body weight capped at 100 kg for dose calculation in practice). Cumulative peripheral neuropathy: assess and hold/reduce for grade 2 or higher. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: A+AVD 'A' (doxorubicin). DOXOrubicin 25 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Anthracycline cumulative cardiotoxicity warn 450 / hard 550 mg/m2. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Vinblastine
drugs.notes: A+AVD 'V'. Vinblastine 6 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. IV only. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Dacarbazine
drugs.notes: A+AVD 'D'. Dacarbazine 375 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
